caption: A large, clear balloon is inflated with air, showing the internal pressure causing the balloon to stretch.

observations.R13C: Balloon remains almost fixed in position and size; sampled frames do not demonstrate inflation/stretching.
observations.R13C_no_c: Balloon shifts vertically and changes appearance slightly; this is not clear evidence of inflation.
observations.R13C_key_modulation_off: Q-only balloon moves vertically, but a convincing inflation sequence is still absent.
observations.score_limitation: Normal, no_c and Q-only all receive SA4/PC5; K-only receives SA3/PC5. Movement and physical process completion must not be conflated.

inference_intervention_scope: Same own400 checkpoint and verified common first-image pixels, caption, seed/noise, gamma and sampler. Historical-reference weights differ.
limitations: Sampled-frame diagnostic, not an aggregate quality score. No measured attention-to-first-frame attribution. More motion alone is not physical correctness. Numerical paired controls cover16 cases.
